claims.text: The screener read this parcel's East Point code MI as industrial (by right). The district's use table (Municode) could not be read, so whether warehouse/distribution is allowed is not confirmed from the text; the verdict is unknown for that reason only, but the by_right reading looks wrong.

open_items: East Point's zoning text is on Municode (known wall) and the city's zoning layer is on an ArcGIS Online host (known wall); a third-party code copy (eastpoint-ga.elaws.us) timed out at robots.txt. Ask East Point Planning & Community Development for a zoning verification letter: confirm the parcel is MI (Medical Institutional), list MI's permitted and use-permit uses, and say whether the Sec. 10-2071 amendment deferred in 2025 was later adopted.

Search-result summaries (third-party, not fetched, not verified) say East Point placed a moratorium on MI applications in October 2024, that council approved a moratorium in December 2023 on reuse of the former Atlanta Medical Center South hospital property next door, and that a city ordinance requires new industrial uses to be one mile (5,280 ft) from residential property. Ask the city whether any of these applies to this parcel; the one-mile rule alone would rule out industrial use here (single-family homes, a school and apartments are within 1,200 ft).
Confirm whether the Cleveland Avenue Overlay District covers the parcel today and what it requires (uses, design, buffers).
Internal streets named 1st, 2nd, 5th, 7th and Long Street appear on the city's own street and overlay maps; ask whether any are public right-of-way crossing the parcel, which would split the site.
